**Public Schools**

* **California Department of Education:** Provides a comprehensive directory of public schools in California: https://www.cde.ca.gov/schooldirectory/
* **Local School Districts:** Each school district in California maintains a website with information about its schools. You can find the website of your local school district by searching online using the name of the district or city.

**Private Schools**

* **California Association of Independent Schools (CAIS):** Represents over 800 private schools in California. Search for schools by location, grade level, and other criteria: https://www.caisca.org/
* **National Association of Independent Schools (NAIS):** Provides a directory of private schools nationwide, including those in California: https://www.nais.org/directory/#search-form
* **Private School Review:** Offers reviews and ratings of private schools in California: https://www.privateschoolreview.com/
* **Independent School Management:** Provides a directory of private schools in California, as well as school profiles and rankings: https://www.ismcalifornia.org/

**Other Resources**

* **Great Schools:** Provides school ratings, reviews, and other information about public and private schools in California: https://www.greatschools.org/california/
* **Niche:** Offers rankings and reviews of schools in California, including public, private, and charter schools: https://www.niche.com/k12/search/best-schools/s/california/
* **US News & World Report:** Ranks high schools in California based on a variety of factors: https://www.usnews.com/best-high-schools/area/california

**Tips for Choosing a School**

* Consider your child's academic needs and goals.
* Visit schools and talk to teachers and administrators to get a feel for the learning environment.
* Read reviews and ratings from other parents and students.
* Consider the school's location, size, and extracurricular activities.
* Apply early to ensure your child's place in the desired school.
